component.name: Tunnelbird
component.summary: Connect to your VPN tunnels in one click

description.p: Tunnelbird imports the .conf tunnel file from your VPN provider or your own server, and connects in one click. It works with the network settings of your system and never needs administrator rights.

ul.li: Preview and edit a tunnel before saving it, with clear errors
One tunnel at a time: switching disconnects the previous one
Live traffic graph, public IP address, country and city
Warns when the server stops answering or the tunnel drops
Connects by itself on untrusted Wi-Fi, never on your own networks
Top bar icon to switch tunnels without opening the window
Share a tunnel as a file or as a QR code for your phone
